AiResponseFormat.description: Present fencing club search results as club cards. Select this response action whenever the response shows one to ten fencing clubs with names, locations, distances or website links. Also select it for a club search with no matching listings or a directory or location error. Do not select it for general fencing explanations.

instructions.instruction: Always use SportCompassClubResults when presenting fencing club search results, including a single club or multiple clubs. Do not replace club cards with only a prose list. Populate the response from the latest Find Nearby Fencing Clubs structuredResultJson output, copying its fields exactly. If that source output is unavailable, use plain text rather than inventing data.
Do not invent clubs, URLs, distances, specialties, freshness or accessibility details. Keep missing URLs null and preserve the accessibilityNote exactly.
For other fencing guidance, greetings, classification questions and human support turns, use the normal plain-text response instead of this format.
